name: Undying Loyalty
text: A fighter can make this reaction when a `VAMPIRE` within 3" of them is targeted by an attack action, after the damage is totalled but before it is allocated, if it is enough for that `VAMPIRE` to be taken out of action. Allocate those damage points, one at a time, to this fighter instead. If this fighter is taken out of action, allocate any remaining damage points to that friendly `VAMPIRE`.

name: Unholy Celerity
text: Once per battle round, this fighter can make a free move action.

name: The Hunger
text: A fighter can use this ability after taking an enemy fighter out of action with a melee attack action. Remove (X) damage points from this fighter, and add a Wyrd Dice to your saved Wyrd Dice.

name: Unbending Will
text: Do not make injury rolls for this fighter. In addition, when this fighter is taken out of action, the warband starts wavering.

name: Chilling Howl
text: Select each enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, those fighters cannot make reactions.

name: Unfeeling Flesh
text: When resolving an attack action against this fighter, if none of the hit rolls score a critical hit, add 1 to this fighter's Armour characteristic.

name: Shambling Horde
text: Select up to (X/2) visible friendly fighters with the `ZOMBIE` keyword. Those fighters can each immediately make a free move action of up to 3", as long as they end that move action closer to this fighter.

name: Gory Feast
text: A `GHOUL` can use this ability if an enemy fighter was taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. Remove (X/2) damage points from each friendly `GHOUL` within 2" of this fighter.
